findings.title: Incomplete strict typing in integration — 515 mypy --strict errors
findings.claim: The integration does not meet platinum-tier strict-typing requirements with mypy --strict.
findings.mechanism: Home Assistant dependency imports lack type stubs (py.typed markers), blocking static type analysis. Function signatures and type annotations are incomplete or absent in several integration modules.

perturbation.change: Add type hints to optimizer.py imports (from typing import Any, Optional)

findings.metric_definition: Total count of errors from mypy --strict --show-error-codes run against custom_components/heatpump_optimizer
findings.phenomenon_property: Integration modules lack type annotations required for platinum-tier quality scale compliance
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Add type hints to function signatures and class attributes; define TypedDict for dynamic entity configuration; create py.typed marker in integration package root

non_findings.claim: Integration test scripts execute without import errors
Feature test suite runs successfully with real setup
mypy strict mode analysis tool is functional
